description.narrative: The project developed a robust MEL system to ensure that the decisions are evidence based and that iterative learning is supported to inform adaptive management. The project developed a Theory of Change (ToC) and KPIs through proposal development processes which will be refined during the inception phase. The MEL system must align with the Step Change program’s MEL framework and meet the associated reporting requirements.

The purpose of the MEL plan is to; o Support learning from experiences of CRAKS implementation from local to national level and use evidence to inform adaptive management as well as inform other climate change adaptation initiatives. o Support evidence-based decision making by ACTADE and IIED using project outcomes both at national and local levels to enhance locally led adaptation. o Support upward and downward knowledge brokering processes as well as results in terms of quantity, quality, and effectiveness of the project. o Devise participatory methods that will allow local organisations and communities to contribute to the change process and share feedback on project implementation processes. o Support reporting to the donor as well as provide lessons for wider learning with other Step Change projects and external stakeholders.
